# Edgar A. Dikenge

Edgar A. Dikenge is a Software Engineer based in Luanda, Angola (WAT / UTC+1), specializing in pragmatic software architecture, API security, enterprise integrations, backend platforms, idempotent financial flows, and API-led architectures. He champions choosing software patterns based on real trade-offs: from well-bounded modular monoliths to BFF layers over legacy cores and event-driven architectures.

In an era dominated by rapid AI development, Edgar emphasizes Security by Design (OAuth2/JWT authentication, input sanitization, data encryption, RBAC, signed webhooks, and OWASP compliance) as a mandatory foundation for all production software.

Edgar currently serves as a Software Engineer at Nossa Seguros, designing secure BFF layers over legacy insurance core systems (Cleva) using MuleSoft, integration pipelines in Azure DevOps, and idempotent payment processing.

## Technical Surface & Stack
- **Enterprise Integrations & Fintech:** MuleSoft (Anypoint Platform, API-Led), Cleva Insurance Platform, AppyPay (Multicaixa GPO Express), Stripe, Strapi CMS.
- **Core Backend & Security:** Java 21 / Spring Boot 3, TypeScript / NestJS, Python (Django, Automation), OAuth2 / JWT / RBAC, REST APIs, gRPC, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ.
- **Persistence, Caching & Storage:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis (Cache & Session Store), MinIO (S3 Object Storage), Flyway Migrations, Prisma ORM.
- **DevOps, Security & Quality:** Azure DevOps (CI/CD Pipelines), Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher Manager, Linux, SonarQube / OWASP Scanner, Integration Testing.
